Sorry if **v1.5.5.9** left you with blank app tiles — the new bento grid looked fine on my Proxmox box, but some Docker/Unraid setups only showed the card header (name + **ONLINE**) with an empty body underneath. That's [#15](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/15). **v1.5.6.0** is the fix.

### Fixed

- **Blank card bodies** — CPU/RAM rows and *arr integration stats show again (CSS flex/overflow clash with stretched bento cells)
- **Integration cards** — a small loading row appears right away while stats fetch, instead of a dead empty gap
- **Drag reorder** — moving apps around works reliably again; the handle only targets the app grid, not the widgets row above it

### Docs

- [Dashboard Widgets](https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/dashboard-widgets) guide trimmed to three simple copy-paste examples
- Troubleshooting note for “ONLINE shows but body empty”
- Settings label for link widgets: `url|label` per line

### Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh the dashboard after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R` / `Cmd+Shift+R`).

If you're on Unraid and still see blank tiles after pulling `latest`, please reply on [#15](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/15) with your browser and whether container metrics are enabled — I want to confirm this lands for you.
